question: How many posts are there at the European Labour Authority? How many were actually filled in 2022 and 2023, and how many are currently filled?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (9.7.2024) The information on staff employed by the European Labour Authority (ELA) is available in the ELA’s Single Programming Documents, Consolidated Annual Activity Reports and Draft General Budget of the European Union, Working Document Part III.

According to the Single Programming Document 2024-20261 and Working Document Part III of the Draft General Budget of the European Union, COM(2023) 300 and COM(2024)3002, 117 out of 132 posts were filled (comprising temporary and contract agents, and seconded national experts) in ELA on 31 December 2022 and 140 out of 144 on 31 December 2023.

The Commission does not have information on the number of posts currently occupied in the ELA, as this is a decentralised agency, with its own legal personality and independent from the Commission. The Agency is therefore best placed to reply to this question.
